blocking.section: Problem and why now / The problem
blocking.issue: The sentence says Apache APISIX's AI plugins became free in 3.18, which implies they were paid or unavailable before. The research does not support that. APISIX is Apache-2.0 for the whole project, including all AI plugins. ai-proxy-multi gained Bedrock/Anthropic Messages in 3.17, and ai-rate-limiting is documented as free with no version gate. What 3.18 added was the semantic ai-cache and Redis-backed distributed token counters. There was no licensing change in 3.18. (Reviewer note: this wording came from the fix L4C proposed in the previous round. It is corrected here.)
blocking.evidence: Line 33: "The main exceptions are Apache APISIX, whose AI plugins are free since 3.18 ([source](https://apisix.apache.org/blog/2026/08/20/release-apache-apisix-3.18.0/))". Contradicting source: competitors-kong-tyk-apisix.md section 10 "License: Apache-2.0 for the project, including all AI plugins (https://github.com/apache/apisix)"; section 4.3 "Bedrock/Anthropic Messages added in 3.17 | Free (Apache-2.0)", "ai-rate-limiting ... | Free" and "Semantic cache | ai-cache (3.18) ... | Free".
blocking.fix: Replace with: "The main exceptions are Apache APISIX, whose AI plugins are Apache-2.0 ([source](https://github.com/apache/apisix)) and gained a semantic cache and distributed token counters in 3.18 ([source](https://apisix.apache.org/blog/2026/08/20/release-apache-apisix-3.18.0/)), and Envoy Gateway, ..." (rest unchanged).

blocking.section: Open source and business model / Revenue

blocking.evidence: Line 196: "RBAC and audit log, paid at Tyk AI Studio EE ([source](https://github.com/TykTechnologies/ai-studio))". Contradicting source: licensing-landscape.md section 6 row "Free in CE | ... | Core gateway, chat, tools, basic user management and RBAC, cost tracking/analytics (https://github.com/TykTechnologies/ai-studio)" and "EE-only: budget management/enforcement, advanced SSO (SAML, OIDC), advanced RBAC, audit logging"; section 8.3 "Tyk AI Studio EE advanced RBAC".
blocking.fix: Change to: "advanced RBAC and audit logging, paid at Tyk AI Studio EE ([source](https://github.com/TykTechnologies/ai-studio))". Optionally add Gravitee EE custom roles and audit trail ([source](https://documentation.gravitee.io/apim/introduction/enterprise-edition)) as a second example of paid RBAC.
